label: Image Caption (LM Studio)
description: Captions/tags images under media/ using any vision-capable model currently loaded in LM Studio. Enter the exact model id as shown by LM Studio (e.g. prism-ml/bonsai-27b, qwen/qwen3.8-27b). Each model's result is kept separately in the sidecar, so trying several while you find one that fits your machine doesn't lose earlier attempts.
